Returns the storage deposit for a UTXO with effective size $0. Effective size = utxoBytes + indexValuesTupleBytes + N*33, where N is the number of index-values entries (per-entry trie cost charged on top of the in-UTXO bytes). Computed Go-side in ledger.effectiveStorageSize.

Piecewise-linear schedule (continuous at the kink, size = 100):
  size <  100 -> deposit = size * 50_000
  size >= 100 -> deposit = size * 50_000 + (size - 100) * 4 * 50_000

Algebraically simplified second branch to a single multiplication:
  size * 50_000 + (size - 100) * 200_000
    = size * 250_000 - 20_000_000
